summary: OpenAI announced a shopping and product discovery feature in ChatGPT built on an Agentic Commerce Protocol that lets users compare products and interact with merchants directly within the chat interface.

mechanisms.reason: The feature routes product discovery and merchant transactions through an agent-driven protocol rather than traditional browsing or seat-based shopping software.
mechanisms.quote: ChatGPT introduces richer, visually immersive shopping powered by the Agentic Commerce Protocol, enabling product discovery, side-by-side comparisons, and merchant integration.

categories.reason: Merchant integration and product comparison inside ChatGPT could redirect discovery traffic away from or through existing consumer marketplaces.
categories.quote: enabling product discovery, side-by-side comparisons, and merchant integration
